import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    L = np.log(P)
    return (params[0]*P + params[1]*P*L + params[2]*P**2 + params[3] + params[4]*t + params[5]*t**2
            + params[6]*P*t + params[7]*P*L*t + params[8]*P*L*t**2 + params[9]*np.exp(-t))
